lead: Babul Supriyo is an Indian actor, born on 15 December 1970 in Uttarpara Kotrung.
As of 2026, he is 55 years old, and his birth date places him under the Sagittarius sign.
He has 16 credited works on public record and has held the office of Member of the 16th Lok Sabha and Member of the 17th Lok Sabha.
This profile collects the Babul facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Babul Supriyo — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Babul Supriyo was born on 15 December 1970 in Uttarpara Kotrung, and holds Indian nationality.
He received his education at Serampore College, Don Bosco High & Technical School, Liluah and Don Bosco Bandel.
He is recorded as speaking Bangla.

sections.heading: Babul Supriyo — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists actor, politician and singer as his occupations.

He has held the following offices: Member of the 16th Lok Sabha (2014–2019), Member of the 17th Lok Sabha (2019–2021) and Member of the 17th West Bengal Legislative Assembly. He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
